mentions.name: GetMarketAlerts
mentions.description: This site helps investors keep track of the stocks they follow. It automatically sets alerts when a stock is favorited, lets users discuss and analyze stocks with AI, and generates AI research reports.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been building a site to help me keep track of the stocks I follow.

* Automatically sets alerts when I favorite a stock

* Discuss and analyze stocks with AI

* Generate AI research reports
